corrections.why: Wikipedia gives the summit at 4,048 ft (1,234 m) at nearly the same coordinates as the record, and FFLA-SDRC gives 4051 ft/1235 m. The register's 3,168 ft (966 m) looks inconsistent with the summit, so the editor should decide which figure to keep.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says torn down in 1983; FFLA-SDRC says standing in 1979 and demolished or removed by 1986. The story reports both.
The register gives Region 5 BC-301 and FFLA-SDRC gives Region 5 C3; both describe a 14x14-ft live-in wood cab. The story gives the size and not the code.
The register gives 3,168 ft (966 m); FFLA-SDRC gives 4051 ft/1235 m; Wikipedia gives 4,048 ft (1,234 m) for the summit. The story says the sources differ.

notes_for_editor: Built year, design size and 1975 last staffing come from the register; the FFLA-SDRC page supports the 1979 sighting and the 1986 window. Removal date is disputed (1983 vs by 1986), and the story reports both. Elevation disagrees: the register's 3,168 ft (966 m) vs about 4,048-4,051 ft at nearly the same coordinates, so the correction is only proposed. The cab code differs (BC-301 vs C3), so the story gives only the 14x14-ft size. No source says whether the public can reach the repeater site, so access is omitted rather than guessed. Do not confuse with the San Bernardino NF Black Mountain Lookout on Barton Peak, a different tower.
